g.text: Editor, M4 Metal, 1536² RGBA16F. HDR point bilinearly splatted into 4 texels, moved 1/16 px
per frame diagonally for 64 frames. The ideal Gaussian of the same splat also varies in peak.
Values below the floor are drawn at it. Sigma and value axes are logarithmic.
